en: Black-and-white (slightly tinted) postcard view of a long, rectangular historic building with a steep tiled roof and multiple dormer windows. A small tower with a clock or bell and spire rises from the roof. The building is partly screened by trees and shrubs, with an open lawn in the foreground. At the top left, red printed text reads "Elsterwerda. Schloss." indicating the depicted site.
